newsitem.title: JAPAN: Showpla Asia expected to be listed on OSE in Aug.
newsitem.headline: Showpla Asia expected to be listed on OSE in Aug.

text.p: Showa Plastics Co Ltd said on Monday that its Singapore affiliate Showpla Asia Ltd is expected to be listed on the foreign section of the Osaka Securities Exchange in August.
The Osaka bourse established its foreign section in October last year. Showpla is expected to be the first company to list its shares on the section, a bourse official said.
Japanese plastic parts manufacturer Showa Plastics had a 34.38 percent stake in the Singapore firm as of the end of 1996.
Showpla said on Monday in Singapore that its director, Teruyuki Nakagawa, had sold his shareholding of 400,000 shares at US$0.405 each.
The sale, which represented 0.005 percent of the company's issued share capital, left Nakagawa with no Showpla shares.
Showa Plastics said that Showpla's listing on the OSE would be in late August.
Showa Plastics also said that Showpla would boost its capital by allocating new shares to existing shareholders in August in order to obtain funds to expand its business.

The number of Showpla's outstanding shares will rise to 160 million shares as a result of the planned capital increase, up from the current 80 million, Showa Plastics said. It added Showpla's capital will rise to S$40 million from S$20 million at present.
Showpla plans to list 32 million shares, or 20 percent, of its outstanding shares, Showa Plastics said.
